profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary: Working on iOS products since 2010, now doing some more fun stuff @ Facebook

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I have been working on various products at Evernote. Penultimate, Evernote iOS, Evernote Mac, etc. Tech lead of the Evernote SDK for iOS (https://github.com/evernote/evernote-cloud-sdk-ios). My team brought the business card scanning magic to Evernote users and LinkedIn thinks we are the best out there http://blog.linkedin.com/2014/05/07/evernote-linkedin-partnership/.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in THE iOS team. Tech lead of the Nike+ app on iOS 7. Also proud of fixing a bunch of UIKit and MediaPlayer bugs. A few of those dated back to the ORIGINAL iPhone. You're welcome.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined the team to change the world with how people interact and share experience through their mobile devices, crafting pixel perfect apps in downtown Palo Alto

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
We built an iPhone app that helps people to connect, utilized the social graph data from Facebook and geo information from users's phones, and created a social network on the go
Our app is available at: http://oneaway.me/

positions.title: Intern, iPhone/iPad development
positions.description: First professional valuable experience with iOS development
